decisions.label: Acinar Cell Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm with acinar cell differentiation, arising from the secretory cells of exocrine glands such as the pancreas, salivary glands, or lungs.

verification.note: NCIT:C4197 Acinar Cell Neoplasm; confirmed as direct ancestor of Acinar Cell Carcinoma; matches ICD-O morphology category 8550-8559.

decisions.label: Glandular Cell Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from or exhibiting the features of glandular epithelium; encompasses a broad morphological category including adenomas, adenocarcinomas, and related glandular tumors.

verification.note: NCIT:C7132 Glandular Cell Neoplasm; the ICD-O category 'Adenomas and Adenocarcinomas' (8140-8389) covers glandular tumors broadly. NCIT:C7132 is the umbrella morphology class but does not restrict to adenoma/adenocarcinoma subtypes only.

decisions.label: Adnexal Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from skin appendage structures, including hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and eccrine or apocrine sweat glands.

verification.note: NCIT:C212119 Adnexal Neoplasm; confirmed as direct ancestor of multiple skin appendage tumors; semantically equivalent to ICD-O category 'Adnexal and Skin Appendage Neoplasms' (8390-8429).

decisions.label: Epithelial Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm derived from epithelial cells, the cells lining the surfaces and cavities of the body.

verification.note: NCIT:C3709 Epithelial Neoplasm; confirmed as ancestor of numerous carcinomas and epithelial tumors; matches ICD-O category 'Epithelial Neoplasms, NOS' (8000-8009).

decisions.label: Fibroepithelial Neoplasm
decisions.description: A benign, borderline, or malignant neoplasm characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a fibrous component. Representative examples are fibroadenoma and phyllodes tumor.

verification.note: NCIT:C3743 Fibroepithelial Neoplasm; exact label match; definition confirmed from OLS. Matches ICD-O category 9010-9016.

decisions.label: Fibromatosis
decisions.description: A poorly circumscribed neoplasm arising from the soft tissues, characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and an infiltrative growth pattern.

verification.note: NCIT:C3042 Fibromatosis; ICD-O 'Fibromatous Neoplasms' (8810-8829) includes fibromas and fibromatosis. NCIT:C3042 specifically describes fibromatosis; a broader 'Fibromatous Neoplasm' parent class is not a distinct NCIT term.

decisions.label: Germ Cell Tumor
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from germ cells, the primordial cells that give rise to eggs and sperm.

verification.note: NCIT:C3708 Germ Cell Tumor; confirmed as ancestor of multiple germ cell tumors; semantically equivalent to ICD-O category 9060-9091.

decisions.label: Giant Cell Tumor
decisions.description: A neoplasm characterized by the presence of multinucleated giant cells intermixed with mononuclear stromal cells.

verification.note: NCIT:C3055 Giant Cell Tumor; confirmed as ancestor of Malignant Tenosynovial Giant Cell Tumor and related tumors; matches ICD-O category 9250-9252.

decisions.label: Glioma
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from glial cells of the central nervous system, including astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, and ependymal cells.

verification.note: NCIT:C3059 Glioma; standard NCIT term for ICD-O category 9380-9460.

decisions.label: Leukemia
decisions.description: A malignant clonal hematologic disorder involving hematopoietic stem cells, characterized by the presence of primitive or atypical myeloid or lymphoid cells in the bone marrow and blood.

verification.note: NCIT:C3161 Leukemia; confirmed as direct match via OLS search; semantically equivalent to ICD-O category 9800-9948.

decisions.label: Lipomatous Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from adipose (fat) tissue, ranging from benign lipomas to malignant liposarcomas.

verification.note: NCIT:C4248 Lipomatous Neoplasm; confirmed as direct parent of Liposarcoma in OLS search; matches ICD-O category 8850-8881.

decisions.label: Meningioma
decisions.description: A usually benign neoplasm arising from the meninges, the membranes that cover and protect the brain and spinal cord.

verification.note: NCIT:C3230 Meningioma; standard NCIT term confirmed as ancestor in prior session searches; matches ICD-O category 9530-9539.

decisions.label: Mesothelial Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from mesothelial cells, which line the body cavities including the pleura, peritoneum, and pericardium.

verification.note: NCIT:C3786 Mesothelial Neoplasm; confirmed as parent of mesothelial tumor types in prior session; matches ICD-O category 9050-9055.

decisions.label: Myelodysplastic Syndrome
decisions.description: A heterogeneous group of clonal hematopoietic stem cell disorders characterized by ineffective blood cell production, peripheral blood cytopenias, and risk of progression to acute myeloid leukemia.

verification.note: NCIT:C3247 Myelodysplastic Syndrome; exact label match; matches ICD-O category 9980-9989.

decisions.label: Myomatous Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from or exhibiting differentiation toward muscle tissue, encompassing tumors of smooth, skeletal, or cardiac muscle.

verification.note: NCIT:C214799 Myomatous Neoplasm; confirmed as direct parent of Myoma (NCIT:C4882) in OLS search; exact label match for ICD-O category 8890-8899.

decisions.label: Neoplasm
decisions.description: An abnormal tissue growth resulting from uncontrolled and progressive cell proliferation; may be benign or malignant.

verification.note: NCIT:C3262 Neoplasm; root morphology class; matches ICD-O category 'Neoplasms, NOS' (8000-8009 basis). Appropriate for the generic NOS category.

decisions.label: Nerve Sheath Neoplasm
decisions.description: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the perineural cells in the sheaths surrounding the nerves. Representative examples include neurofibroma, schwannoma, and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor.

verification.note: NCIT:C4972 Nerve Sheath Neoplasm; confirmed as direct ancestor in OLS search; semantically equivalent to ICD-O category 9540-9571.

decisions.label: Melanocytic Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from melanocytes, the pigment-producing cells found primarily in the skin and eye; includes both benign lesions (nevi) and malignant melanomas.

verification.note: NCIT:C7058 Melanocytic Neoplasm; confirmed as ancestor of Benign Conjunctival Melanocytic Neoplasm in OLS search; the class covers both nevi and melanomas as intended by the vocab term.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT general qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Otherwise Specified
decisions.description: A term used to indicate that a specific type or category is not more precisely described or classified.

verification.note: NCIT:C19594 Not Otherwise Specified; standard NCIT general qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Reported
decisions.description: Not provided or available at the time of data submission.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT general qualifier.

decisions.label: Odontogenic Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from tissues involved in tooth formation, including enamel organ, dental papilla, and dental follicle, most commonly arising in the jaw.

verification.note: NCIT:C3286 Odontogenic Neoplasm; confirmed as direct ancestor of Dentinogenic Ghost Cell Tumor in OLS search; semantically equivalent to ICD-O category 9270-9342.

decisions.label: Paraganglioma
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from paraganglia, specialized clusters of neuroendocrine cells that are part of the autonomic nervous system, located at various sites outside the adrenal medulla.

verification.note: NCIT:C3308 Paraganglioma; confirmed as ancestor of Jugulotympanic Paraganglioma in OLS search; the vocab term also includes glomus tumors (ICD-O 8711), which are glomangiomas/glomus tumors of soft tissue — a distinct NCIT lineage not captured by C3308.

decisions.label: Plasma Cell Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm characterized by the clonal proliferation of plasma cells, the antibody-secreting terminally differentiated B-cells.

verification.note: NCIT:C4665 Plasma Cell Neoplasm; confirmed as ancestor of Multiple Myeloma in prior session; matches ICD-O category 9731-9759.

decisions.term: Soft Tissue Tumors and Sarcomas, NOS
decisions.label: Soft Tissue Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from the non-epithelial, non-osseous supporting tissues of the body, including fat, fibrous tissue, muscle, peripheral nerves, and blood and lymph vessels.

verification.note: NCIT:C3377 Soft Tissue Neoplasm; confirmed as ancestor of multiple soft tissue tumors in OLS search. The vocab term implies a broader category including sarcomas specifically; NCIT:C3377 covers both benign and malignant soft tissue tumors.

decisions.label: Squamous Cell Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from or exhibiting the features of squamous epithelium, ranging from benign squamous papillomas to squamous cell carcinomas.

verification.note: NCIT:C3792 Squamous Cell Neoplasm; confirmed in prior session searches; matches ICD-O category 8050-8089.

decisions.label: Synovial Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from the synovial tissue lining joint cavities, tendon sheaths, and bursae.

verification.note: NCIT:C8964 Synovial Neoplasm; confirmed as ancestor of Malignant Tenosynovial Giant Cell Tumor and Malignant Synovial Neoplasm in OLS search; semantically equivalent to ICD-O category 9040-9044.

decisions.label: Thymus Epithelial Neoplasm
decisions.description: A neoplasm arising from the epithelial cells of the thymus gland, spanning a spectrum from thymoma to thymic carcinoma.

verification.note: NCIT:C6450 Thymus Epithelial Neoplasm; confirmed as ancestor of Combined Thymus Epithelial Neoplasm and Thymoma A in OLS search; matches ICD-O category 8580-8589.

decisions.label: Gestational Trophoblastic Disorder
decisions.description: A group of pregnancy-related proliferative disorders including non-neoplastic conditions and trophoblastic neoplasms such as invasive hydatidiform mole, gestational choriocarcinoma, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor.

verification.note: NCIT:C180633 Gestational Trophoblastic Disorder; the ICD-O 'Trophoblastic neoplasms' category (9100-9105) specifically covers neoplasms, while C180633 includes both non-neoplastic and neoplastic trophoblastic conditions. No dedicated 'Trophoblastic Neoplasm' class without the gestational qualifier found in NCIT.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C17998 Unknown; standard NCIT general qualifier.
